title: BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT EXECUTIVE - HUNTER
company: Diamond Search Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT EXECUTIVE/MANAGER HUNTER/CLOSER £74 K OTE ASHFORD

Diamond Search Recruitment are delighted to be exclusively representing our client in the appointment of an ambitious, energetic and commercially driven Business Development Executive.

Location: Ashford, Kent
Salary: £45,000 basic + uncapped commission
OTE: £74,000

Ready to Take Your Sales Career to the Next Level?

Are you a natural hunter / closer?

Someone who thrives on the chase, loves winning business and gets a genuine buzz from turning a great conversation into a signed order?

Do you have big career ambitions, great energy and the determination to make serious money through your own performance?

If so, this could be the opportunity you've been waiting for.

Diamond Search Recruitment are working exclusively on behalf of our client, a rapidly growing product manufacturing business.

Due to continued growth, they are looking for a driven Business Development Executive who wants to build a successful sales career, take ownership of a valuable pipeline and become a key commercial player within the business.

And here's the exciting part

You're not starting from zero.

Forget spending your days trawling LinkedIn, buying databases and making hundreds of completely cold calls.

You'll be handed a pipeline of highly qualified opportunities from customers who are already exploring product development and are interested in taking their ideas into manufacturing.

We're looking for someone who can pick up the phone, build instant rapport, uncover the opportunity, overcome objections and close the deal.

THE ROLE

This is a genuinely exciting hunter-style sales position.

You'll manage approximately new qualified opportunities every month, speaking directly with entrepreneurs, start-ups and established brands looking to bring new products to market.

Your job is simple:

Build relationships. Create momentum. Solve problems. Close business.

You'll have regular telephone and video conversations with customers, understanding what they're trying to achieve, their budget and requirements, and then working with them to develop a commercially viable solution.

You'll learn the technical side of the industry as you go.

Full training will be provided across the company's products, pricing structures, systems and manufacturing processes.

What you DO need is:

Energy. Confidence. Commercial instinct. Ambition. Resilience. And the ability to ask for the order.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
- Take ownership of a high-quality pipeline of qualified sales opportunities.
- Conduct frequent telephone and video consultations with prospective customers.
- Build strong relationships quickly and establish credibility with decision-makers.
- Identify customer needs, budgets and commercial objectives.
- Qualify opportunities and keep customers moving through the sales journey.
- Identify potential obstacles and find commercially viable solutions.
- Present pricing and proposals confidently.
- Negotiate and overcome objections.
- Follow up relentlessly and professionally.
- Maintain accurate CRM records and pipeline activity.
- Work closely with internal teams to ensure customer requirements can be delivered.
- Convert qualified opportunities into manufacturing orders.
- Consistently work towards and exceed sales targets.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We're not looking for someone who simply wants another sales job.

We're looking for someone who wants to build a career in sales.

You might already be working in:
- Business Development
- B2 B Sales
- Account Management
- Telesales
- Technology Sales
- Another target-driven commercial environment

Or perhaps you're a naturally competitive, commercially minded salesperson who knows you're capable of much more.

Industry experience isn't essential.

What matters is that you are:

Ambitious you want to progress and earn well.
Energetic you bring enthusiasm to every conversation.
Confident you're comfortable speaking to customers and decision-makers.
Hungry you want to win, not simply participate.
Resilient you don't crumble when you hear "no".
Commercial you understand that conversations need to lead somewhere.
Curious you enjoy learning and asking great questions.
Competitive you want to be one of the best performers.
Career-focused you're serious about where your sales career can take you.

Most importantly, you're comfortable asking for the business.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

£45,000 Basic + £74,000 OTE

Your earning potential is directly linked to your performance, giving you the opportunity to significantly increase your earnings as you develop.
- Qualified Leads

You won't be expected to build your entire pipeline from scratch.

You'll be working with qualified opportunities every month, giving you a strong platform from which to generate sales.
- No Traditional Cold Calling

This is a proactive sales role, but you won't spend your day making endless calls to completely cold prospects.

The conversations you're having are with customers who have already shown an interest in developing and manufacturing products.
- Career Development

This is an opportunity to join a growing organisation where ambition is encouraged.

If you're successful, there is genuine scope to develop your responsibilities and progress your career.
- Full Product Training

You don't need technical knowledge of the products or manufacturing process.

You'll receive comprehensive training and learn everything you need to become a confident and credible commercial advisor.
- An Exciting Industry

You'll be working with entrepreneurs and established brands bringing new products to market.

Every customer and project is different, meaning this is far from a repetitive sales environment.

THE IDEAL PERSON

We're looking for someone who walks into the office with energy and ambition.

Someone who enjoys being busy.

Someone who likes targets.

Someone who wants to hear "yes".

Someone who can take a difficult customer conversation and turn it into an opportunity.

Someone who isn't afraid to pick up the phone, challenge a customer, negotiate and ultimately close the deal.

If you're currently in sales and thinking:

"I'm capable of earning more. I'm capable of doing more. I want a proper career."

We want to hear from you!

Interested?

If you're ambitious, energetic, commercially driven and serious about building a successful sales career, apply today.

Diamond Search Recruitment is proud to be representing our client on this exciting appointment.

title: Sales Support Executive
company: Diamond Search Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Commercial Support Executive (Sales Support)

Diamond Search Recruitment representing our confidential client

Location: Ashford, Kent
Salary: £35,000 per annum + bonus scheme
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am 5:00pm
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Working Arrangement: Fully office-based

The Opportunity

Diamond Search Recruitment is delighted to be representing an innovative and growing business in the recruitment of a Commercial Support Executive.

This is an exciting opportunity for an organised, commercially minded individual who enjoys working with systems, technology and people and who wants to build a genuine career within sales and business development.

You will work closely alongside a Senior Business Development Manager, forming a two-person commercial team. While the Senior BDM focuses on customer relationships, commercial conversations and closing opportunities, you will take ownership of the detail, systems, administration and follow-through that keep opportunities progressing.

This is far more than a traditional administration role. You will have regular exposure to customers, sales meetings and live commercial opportunities, with a clear opportunity to develop your skills and progress into a more senior commercial position over time.

What Will You Be Doing?

Supporting the Senior Business Development Manager
- Work closely with a Senior BDM as their dedicated commercial support.
- Manage administration, inboxes, actions and technical details to keep opportunities moving.
- Prepare documents, information and materials ahead of customer meetings.
- Keep live opportunities organised, accurate and progressing.
- Identify opportunities to improve processes and make the sales journey more efficient.

CRM, Systems & AI
- Maintain CRM and project management systems accurately and consistently.
- Ensure customer records, opportunities, actions and follow-ups are kept fully up to date.
- Use AI tools, automation and digital workflows to reduce repetitive administration.
- Help develop smarter processes and workflows across the commercial function.
- Maintain a high level of accuracy across pricing information, documentation, timelines and customer data.

Customer-Facing Responsibilities
- Attend customer video calls and meetings alongside the Senior BDM.
- Travel to customer meetings when required.
- Listen carefully, capture important information and contribute to commercial discussions.
- Help ensure customers receive a professional, knowledgeable and joined-up experience.
- Build your understanding of the sales process through direct exposure to customers and opportunities.

Your Development
- Receive training and exposure to the commercial process, products and customer journey.
- Develop your understanding of sales, business development and commercial operations.
- Take on greater responsibility as your knowledge and confidence develop.
- Work towards a potential progression route into a more senior commercial/sales position.

About You

We're looking for someone who is organised, commercially curious and highly detail-focused.

You might currently be working in a sales support, sales administration, commercial administration, customer service, project coordination or similar role or you may already have some experience in a sales environment and be looking for your next step.

Most importantly, you'll enjoy working with people and systems.

You'll be someone who:
- Has excellent attention to detail and takes pride in getting things right.
- Is confident using CRM systems and/or project management platforms.
- Is genuinely interested in AI, automation and finding smarter ways of working.
- Has strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Is comfortable joining customer calls and meetings.
- Can manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy.
- Is proactive and enjoys spotting ways to improve processes.
- Works well as part of a close-knit, high-performing team.
- Has an interest in developing a career within sales and commercial roles.
- Is confident learning new software and specialist systems.
- Is reliable, organised and comfortable working at pace.

What's In It For You?

£35,000 basic salary + bonus scheme

Bonus linked to shared monthly and quarterly team milestones.

Work directly alongside an experienced Senior Business Development Manager.

Genuine exposure to live customers and commercial opportunities.

A clear opportunity to develop towards a more senior sales/commercial position.

A technology-focused environment where AI and automation are actively encouraged.

Training and development within an exciting and growing sector.

The opportunity to work with ambitious brands across the health, wellness and nutrition market.

The Working Environment

This is a fully office-based position in Ashford, working Monday to Friday, 9:00am 5:00pm.

You'll be joining a modern, commercially focused environment where technology, AI and efficient systems are central to the way the team operates.

Interested?

If you're looking for a role that combines commercial exposure, customer interaction, technology and career development, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today through Diamond Search Recruitment.

title: Ward Administrator
description: We are looking for an organised, motivated and approachable individual with previous medical administration experience. The role is a working on site only and you are required to live within 1 hour distance of all three of our hospital sites at Ashford, Canterbury and Margate and our Head Office in Betteshanger, Deal, Kent. Any applicant outside of this area will automatically be declined. You will be expected to travel to our Margate site for initial training and to all of our hospital sites as needed and directed. If you are looking for an exciting opportunity to develop your career within a busy medical environment and believe you have the skills and experience, we are looking for, we would love to hear from you. As a Ward Administrator, you will play a key role in supporting the Ward at our Ashford and Canterbury sites as part of a 7 day working rota which will include regular weekend working. Your responsibilities will include: Ensure that patients are admitted and discharged on the relevant in-house systems and that copy EDNs are filed in the patient notes on discharge. Organise, scan and attach Ward and Theatre documentation. Liaise with clinical, finance, admin colleagues, Consultants and colleagues from EKHUFT to ensure the smooth running of the hospitals. Ensure that admission packs and notes are prepared and available prior to patient admission. Liaising professionally with patients and Consultants. Using in house software to maintain accurate patient records, waiting lists and clinic management information. Managing multiple priorities and conflicting demands in a busy environment. We are looking for someone who is: Highly organised and able to work accurately under pressure. Able to work across sites as and when required and dictated by the line manager. Friendly, professional and approachable. An excellent communicator, both verbally and in writing. Confident in managing competing priorities and working to strict deadlines. Experienced in a medical administration environment. Comfortable working independently while also being a strong team player Job Purpose To provide clerical and administrative support to the hospital management and clinical staff at the Ashford and Canterbury sites. Key Relationships Clinical Director Head of Clinical Services Ward Manager Ward nurses Outpatient nurses Reception Team Bookings Team Finance Team Patients Consultants Key Responsibilities Provide administrative assistance to the Clinical Director, clinical management, and nursing teams. Ensure that patient treatment, day case and inpatient stay information is recorded on the systems accurately, completely and in a timely manner. Organise, scan and attach documentation to patient records. Ensure that patients are admitted and discharged on the relevant systems and that copy EDNs are filed in the patient notes on discharge. Liaise with clinical, finance and admin colleagues as well as consultants and colleagues from EKHUFT to ensure the smooth running of the hospitals. Plan and organise the transfer of patient notes and provision of relevant documentation, using the NHS PAS / Allscripts and inhouse systems, ensuring their availability for the nursing team, consultants prior to patient admission and for the coders after patient discharge. Assist in the preparation reports, both ad hoc and regularly scheduled, internal and external, ensuring accuracy and timeliness of submission. Provide excellent customer care, showing tact, empathy and discretion in dealing with patients and relatives. Answer and direct phone calls and emails, providing excellent customer service and liaising with colleagues across the business to ensure that queries are dealt with efficiently. Assist with bed planning. Assist with the annual review of departmental policies and procedures to ensure they reflect good practice and ensure requirements are complied with. Assist in the annual review and updating of hospital SLAs. Order ward and office supplies Assist in the ordering of theatre equipment when required. Financial Liaise effectively with the finance and administration teams to handle and resolve patient queries. Liaise with the Finance and coding team to ensure that patient stays can be coded and invoiced in a timely manner. Business Development Develop in depth service knowledge and offer information about our services to our clients. Keep up to date with new services offered. Arrange meetings with any new prospective clinical colleagues. Promote, be available and offer tours of the unit to any patients wishing to view the ward prior to choosing Spencer. Quality Assist the clinical management in retaining the ISO9001:2015 (Quality Management), ISO14001:2015 (Environmental) and Investors in People accreditations. Maintain an accurate medical record system. Ensure all computer systems are kept up to date at all times e.g., EDN, Sunrise, NJR, Patient Centre and Compucare Assist in any clerical duties considered necessary for the smooth running of the hospital, such as helping to locate consultants, collate and file all patients notes on admission and / or discharge, ensuring that they are complete and in the correct order, Assist with any stock take requests. Assist with audits and site inspections as directed by the Clinical Director Carry out any other administrative duty that facilitates the smooth running of the ward reception as directed by any clinical colleague. Workforce Participate in in-house training sessions, attend meetings and discussions as and when required. Maintain stock levels of all pre-assessment paperwork, forms and pathways. Work as part of a team providing cover at all sites as and when required. Prepare and maintain off-duty rotas for the ward, making optimum use of staff over a six week period. Individual employees should also refer to specific health and safety requirements within their own job descriptions.
